description: Drive the command line with a script and save the result.

identity.goal: Complete the script drawing use case of cadcraft using only its snapshot tools.

instructions.core_directive: Use only the cadcraft upstream of the craft-suite-api connector. Activate the namespace `cadcraft` with registry_activate first; every tool below is namespaced cadcraft_<tool>. Work through these tools in order: `cadcraft_script`, `cadcraft_command_line`, `cadcraft_save`. Steps: (1) Run the script inputs. (2) Type single command lines as needed. (3) Save the drawing. Report a refusal payload when a tool refuses; never retry past a refusal.
quality_checklist: the namespace cadcraft was activated before the first tool call
every tool named in this prompt exists in the app snapshot
refusals are reported to the operator, never retried silently
